ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to enforce OCV event versions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNULL(PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c))), OR( ISNULL(OCV_Event_Version__c), OCV_Event_Version__c < PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c) ) )
